```python
# SPECTRA design program: NMOS wide-swing cascode sink mirror, SKY130 1.8 V
# Revision 4: bottom devices biased at a wider Vds-Vdsat margin, cascode gate
# derived from the actual bottom Vdsat, and error predicted from the Vds mismatch
# between reference and output branches.

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_c": (18.0, 14.0, 22.0),   # cascode gm/Id
    "gmid_b": (22.0, 16.0, 24.0),   # bottom gm/Id (higher -> lower Vdsat)
    "Lc":     (4.0, 1.0, 10.0),     # cascode channel length [um]
    "Lb":     (10.0, 4.0, 10.0),    # bottom channel length [um] (long -> low gds)
    "vm":     (0.14, 0.10, 0.16),   # margin of yo above Vdsat_b [V]
}

VDD = 1.8
RB = 200e3  # divider bottom leg [ohm]


def design(p, lut, spec):
    i_in = spec["iin"]
    i_out = spec["iout_target"]
    v_nom = spec["vout_nom"]

    # --- Device sizing: same gm/Id and L within each pair => exact ratio via W ---
    cr = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["Lc"], i_in, vds=0.6)
    co = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["Lc"], i_out, vds=0.6)
    br = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["Lb"], i_in, vds=0.25)
    bo = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["Lb"], i_out, vds=0.25)

    # --- Bottom gate: diode Mg (same size as br) sinks i_in through Rg from VDD ---
    rg = (VDD - br.vgs) / i_in

    # --- Cascode gate: yo = Vdsat_b + vm, vc = Vgs_c + yo, set by divider ---
    yo = bo.vdsat + p["vm"]
    vc = co.vgs + yo
    ra = RB * (VDD / vc - 1.0)

    # --- Netlist ---
    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    n.dev("Mcr", "iin", "vc", "xr", "vss", cr)
    n.dev("Mbr", "xr", "g", "vss", "vss", br)
    n.dev("Mco", "iout", "vc", "yo", "vss", co)
    n.dev("Mbo", "yo", "g", "vss", "vss", bo)
    n.dev("Mg", "g", "g", "vss", "vss", br)
    n.R("Rg", "vdd", "g", rg)
    n.R("Ra", "vdd", "vc", ra)
    n.R("Rb", "vc", "vss", RB)

    # --- First-order predictions ---
    rout_pred = co.gm / (co.gds * bo.gds)

    # Current error: channel-length-modulation mismatch between the reference
    # bottom (Vds ~ vdsat) and output bottom (Vds = yo), plus Mco vs Mcr Vds mismatch.
    vds_br = 0.25
    vds_bo = yo
    dI_bottom = bo.gds * (vds_bo - vds_br)
    dI_casc = co.gds * (v_nom - yo) - cr.gds * (i_in / i_in) * 0.0
    err_pred = 100.0 * (dI_bottom + dI_casc) / i_out

    v_comp_pred = yo + 0.02

    i_div = VDD / (ra + RB)
    power_pred = VDD * (2.0 * i_in + i_div)

    return n, {
        "iout_err_pct": err_pred,
        "rout": rout_pred,
        "v_compliance": v_comp_pred,
        "power": power_pred,
    }
```
